notes: Updates the audited meters window to use the current-month transmission model: 'Current' becomes 'Last reading'; the old previous-period column is removed; a calculated current-month status (Sent / Not sent) is added based on the portal's 'Передавали' date; an editable 'Новое показание' field is available only when the current month is not yet sent; verification information remains visible. Meter reading submission to /meter/value is still disabled. The only POST used is the proven /account/set service call for switching accounts.
